# Trump Super Intelligence

A conversation, not a match. There is no title card, no score, and no game over.

## The line

Type a line and press Return. The reply comes from a pile of written answers. The line you typed is matched against a list of words. Praise, insults, China, the news, winning, a greeting: each one has its own stack, and the game picks one.

## The face

Five pictures sit above the text. Happy, smug, ranting, winning, and a neutral that does not get much use, because the default mood is smug. Call it great and the face softens. Call it a liar, a fake, or a fool and it rants. The square-wave noise drops in pitch with the mood.

There is a cursor. Many people are saying that is the whole game.
